description: This file declares the OnDemandSymbolSupplier class, which provides an interface for supplying debug symbols on demand for crash reporting. It includes method declarations for retrieving symbol files, managing symbol data buffers, and generating symbol files, specifically for use with breakpad on macOS.

classes.name: OnDemandSymbolSupplier
classes.description: A class that supplies debug symbols on demand, managing symbol file retrieval, data buffers, and symbol file generation for modules.

methods.name: GetSymbolFile
methods.description: Retrieves the symbol file path for a given module, with overloads for including symbol data.

methods.name: GetCStringSymbolData
methods.description: Allocates and retrieves symbol data buffer for a module, transferring ownership to the caller.

methods.name: FreeSymbolData
methods.description: Frees the data buffer allocated for a module's symbol data.

methods.name: GetNameForModule
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for a module, used as a key in internal maps.

methods.name: GetLocalModulePath
methods.description: Finds the local filesystem path for a module, possibly different from the minidump path.

methods.name: GetModulePath
methods.description: Returns the full path to a module.

methods.name: GetModuleSymbolFile
methods.description: Returns the symbol file path for a module, or empty if none exists.

methods.name: GenerateSymbolFile
methods.description: Creates a breakpad symbol file for a module, typically stored in /tmp.
